advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Straight Outta Hampton: C.J. Stroud for Tyler Shough.
Pick up Tanner McKee off waivers (+1.2 points a week) and drop Jalen Nailor.

reasons: You're 11-5 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 19%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 32% of the time with the first-round bye and 15% without it. You get the bye in 24% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 8 contenders (173.9 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (10th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 3rd in 2026, 3rd in 2027 and 2nd in 2028 (title chances about 19%, 22%, 17%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 19% to 22%, and your lineup comes out 1.4 points a week ahead overall. C.J. Stroud adds 4.6 points a week for you today, but Tyler Shough is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,008, get 3,680), and it barely changes their lineup (-0.6 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 22% and 17% to 23% and 20%.
You have 5 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Michael Wilson is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (3.9 points a week).
Amon-Ra St. Brown is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (8.4 points a week).
D'Andre Swift's trade value has dropped 29% in 17 days.
Jordan Love's trade value has dropped 18% in 17 days.
Bryce Young's trade value has dropped 34% in 17 days.
